approach: Add a pure check in a new module `crates/athena-core/src/mechanism_explanation.rs`, in the style of `divergence::reconcile` (`crates/athena-core/src/divergence.rs:55`). It takes `Explanation` records (instance, mechanism, typed `Evidence` of kind Prompt, Code, Run or Record, each with a non-blank source) and returns one `Gap` for each missing evidence kind. For the Athena instance (matched case-insensitively) it also returns a gap when no evidence is a Record. Register the module in `lib.rs` next to `divergence` (line 112) with a doc bullet near line 45. Add `crates/athena-core/tests/mechanism_explanation.rs`, modelled on `study_instance_split.rs`. It tests complete and defective explanations, then checks the real spec entry with `parse_spec`, `measure_problem` and `spec_gaps`, with negative tests for a `none` mechanism, a wrong status label, a missing test command and a wrong owner. Fill mechanism, owner and measure of OLY-B-S4-01 in `docs/spec.toml` (measure ends `status: not shown`). Also add the `athena-core --test mechanism_explanation 5.00` line to `xtask/shard-timings.txt`, since the test `checked_in_timings_cover_every_workspace_test_unit` (`xtask/tests/ci_shards.rs:411-421`) fails for a new test file without it. Add a CHANGELOG.md entry and append a new decision to the end of `docs/decisions.md` without editing any earlier entry.

decisions.choice: A pure function over typed explanation records, not a check of the studies/ files.
decisions.reason: No Athena study exists (only studies/firstmate-work-handling is present, per the S1-02 test's fixture list and the brief). A pure function can be tested now and wired in later, as S3-02's `reconcile` was; the measure honestly ends `status: not shown`.

rejected.option: Validate studies/<id>/ claim files in athena-cap-study/src/rules.rs.
rejected.why: The brief puts the study capability and its prompts out of scope, and no Athena instance exists to check.

rejected.option: Add a new record type for explanations.
rejected.why: It would touch check_record_file, AnyRecord and the round-trip test for no gain; the requirement needs only a check.

decisions.choice: Evidence kinds are an enum (Prompt, Code, Run, Record). Every explanation needs Prompt, Code and Run; an Athena explanation also needs a Record. A source counts only when its text is non-blank.
decisions.reason: This mirrors the requirement text: explained through prompts, code and observed runs, with Athena's own records as primary evidence for Athena. A blank source would otherwise pass as evidence.

rejected.option: Make Record evidence replace the run requirement for Athena.
rejected.why: The requirement says records are primary evidence, not the only evidence; the three kinds still apply.
Records belong to Athena only; the brief requires that a non-Athena instance without a record is not flagged.

decisions.choice: Gaps are an enum `Gap { MissingEvidence{instance, mechanism, kind}, NoOwnRecords{instance, mechanism} }` returned in explanation order, then kind order Prompt, Code, Run, then the records gap.
decisions.reason: Tests can assert the exact gap, and nothing is dropped or merged, as in `reconcile`.

rejected.option: Return a bool or a string list.
rejected.why: Criterion 3 requires each test to assert the specific gap.

decisions.choice: Register the new test unit in xtask/shard-timings.txt with a 5.00 estimate, as the S3-02 commit did (HISTORY.txt: c9fb473 changed xtask/shard-timings.txt).
decisions.reason: xtask/tests/ci_shards.rs:411-421 asserts the timed units equal the workspace's test units; without the line `cargo test --workspace` fails.

decisions.choice: Append decision D176 at the end of docs/decisions.md in the D175 format (Case, Decision, Alternatives, Tradeoff, Reversal cost, Provenance). It names no other D number as superseding or amending.
decisions.reason: The deliverable list names docs/decisions.md, and criterion 6 forbids editing an existing entry. Appending shifts no line number, so the line-keyed confirmed links in the backtest (`crates/athena-cli/tests/backtest.rs:146-149`) keep matching. Avoiding supersession wording keeps the backtest condition-a test green.

files.purpose: Pure check `check(&[Explanation]) -> Vec<Gap>` with `EvidenceKind`, `Evidence`, `Explanation` and `Gap`. Module doc names OLY-B-S4-01 and its limit: nothing yet feeds it a real Athena study, so the measure is `status: not shown`.
Add `pub mod mechanism_explanation;` in alphabetical position and a doc bullet beside the `divergence` bullet (line 45).
Tests for complete and defective explanations, the Athena records rule and the non-Athena exemption. The real spec entry test and the negative spec tests are in the same file.
Set the OLY-B-S4-01 mechanism, keep owner `Athena`, and set the measure to end `status: not shown` and name `cargo test -p athena-core --test mechanism_explanation`. No other entry changes.
Register the new test unit `athena-core --test mechanism_explanation 5.00`, required by ci_shards.rs:411-421. It is not on the brief's deliverable list but is not a governance file.
Add an Added bullet under [Unreleased], first, in the style of the S3-02 bullet.
Append D176 at the end of the file, with no change to existing entries.

steps: Create crates/athena-core/src/mechanism_explanation.rs. Add the module doc (OLY-B-S4-01, pure, nothing read or run, limit stated). Define `EvidenceKind {Prompt, Code, Run, Record}`, `Evidence {kind, source}`, `Explanation {instance, mechanism, evidence}`, `Gap::{MissingEvidence{instance,mechanism,kind}, NoOwnRecords{instance,mechanism}}`, and a const `ATHENA_INSTANCE = "athena"`. A kind counts as present when some evidence has that kind and a source that is non-blank after trimming.

Implement `pub fn check(explanations: &[Explanation]) -> Vec<Gap>`: for each explanation in order, push MissingEvidence for each of Prompt, Code, Run that is absent, then push NoOwnRecords when the instance equals `athena` (ASCII case-insensitive) and no Record evidence is present. Add doc comments on every public item.
In crates/athena-core/src/lib.rs add `pub mod mechanism_explanation;` after `pub mod labeled`/`lab` in sorted position, and a doc bullet next to the `divergence` bullet at line 45.

Create crates/athena-core/tests/mechanism_explanation.rs. Add helpers `ev(kind, source)` and `explanation(instance, mechanism, evidence)`. Add the behavior tests listed under criterion 3. Add the spec tests under criteria 1 and 4, copying `owner_problem`, `measure_label_problem` and `real_requirement` from study_instance_split.rs with REQUIREMENT `OLY-B-S4-01` and TEST_COMMAND `cargo test -p athena-core --test mechanism_explanation`. The real-spec test asserts that the mechanism contains both new file paths and `check`.

Edit docs/spec.toml, OLY-B-S4-01 only (about line 2992): mechanism = the `check` function in crates/athena-core/src/mechanism_explanation.rs, which flags a mechanism explanation lacking a prompt, code or observed-run source, or, for Athena, a source from its own records, tested by crates/athena-core/tests/mechanism_explanation.rs; owner stays `Athena`; measure = the test file checks complete and defective explanations and this entry, `check` is not yet run on a real Athena study, then `cargo test -p athena-core --test mechanism_explanation; status: not shown`.
Add `athena-core --test mechanism_explanation 5.00` to xtask/shard-timings.txt after the `athena-core --test divergence 5.00` line.

Add the CHANGELOG.md bullet at the top of `### Added` under `[Unreleased]`. Append D176 to docs/decisions.md in the D175 format (Case, Decision, Alternatives, Tradeoff, Reversal cost, Provenance). Under Provenance, list the files read and the tests run; add no supersede or amend wording and edit no existing entry.
Run `cargo fmt --all --check`, `cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings` and `cargo test --locked`. Fix any failure in the new files.

risks.risk: The check could be read as proof that Athena is studied. No Athena study exists, so the requirement is only partly met.
risks.mitigation: The measure ends `status: not shown` and the module doc and D176 state that nothing feeds `check` real explanations yet. This matches S3-02 and S1-02.

risks.risk: The new test file is missing from xtask/shard-timings.txt, so the workspace test fails.
risks.mitigation: Add the line as a plan step; criterion 5 runs the full workspace test, which includes ci_shards.rs.

risks.risk: The backtest tests key on line numbers in docs/decisions.md and flag decision-link wording.
risks.mitigation: Append only at the end; avoid supersede/amend wording in D176. cargo test on the final tree runs the backtest tests.

risks.risk: clippy -D warnings flags the new code (for example, too many arguments or a needless clone).
risks.mitigation: Keep the types plain with derives (Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq) and run clippy on the final tree.

risks.risk: The `spec.toml` edit breaks TOML quoting; the file is long and a parse failure fails every test that reads it.
risks.mitigation: Use a basic string with no embedded double quotes, as in the S3-02 entry, and run the real-spec test, which parses the whole file.

demonstrations.method: The real-spec test parses docs/spec.toml with `parse_spec` and finds OLY-B-S4-01. A Grep of docs/spec.toml shows the same entry.
demonstrations.observes: Mechanism is not `none` and contains `crates/athena-core/src/mechanism_explanation.rs` and `crates/athena-core/tests/mechanism_explanation.rs`. Owner is `Athena`. The measure ends `status: not shown` and contains `cargo test -p athena-core --test mechanism_explanation`.
demonstrations.fails_without: With the entry left at mechanism `none` and measure `The spec gap list; status: requirement`, the not-none assertion, the measure-label assertion and the missing-file-name assertions fail.
demonstrations.seam: Entry point: `hestia::parse_spec(&str)` (crates/athena-core/src/hestia.rs:1172) on the real docs/spec.toml, read with a CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR-relative path as `study_instance_split.rs` does. Fixture: the real file; nothing is injected. The seam exists.

demonstrations.method: The test file imports `athena_core::mechanism_explanation::{check, Explanation, Evidence, EvidenceKind, Gap}`; it compiles only if the module is `pub mod mechanism_explanation` in lib.rs. A Grep of lib.rs shows the registration and its doc bullet. The tests drive the pure function with explanation records.
demonstrations.observes: The module compiles and is public. `check` returns an empty list for a complete explanation, one MissingEvidence gap for each absent Prompt, Code or Run, and NoOwnRecords for an Athena explanation without a Record source.
demonstrations.fails_without: Without the module or the registration, the integration test does not compile. Without the Athena rule, the NoOwnRecords test fails.
demonstrations.seam: Entry point: `mechanism_explanation::check(&[Explanation]) -> Vec<Gap>`, added by plan steps 1-2. Fixture: in-test constructed `Explanation` values passed as the argument. No double is used.

demonstrations.method: The tests are: complete_explanation_has_no_gaps; missing_prompt_is_reported; missing_code_is_reported; missing_run_is_reported; a blank source does not count; athena_without_a_record_source_is_reported (it holds prompt, code and run only); athena_with_a_record_is_complete; non_athena_without_records_is_not_flagged (e.g. instance `hermes`); several defects give several gaps in order; and the real-spec test, which calls `parse_spec` and asserts the mechanism is not `none`, `measure_problem(&r.measure) == None`, and the label check passes. A `spec_gaps` assertion verifies that OLY-B-S4-01 is not listed.
demonstrations.observes: Each defect test asserts equality with the exact `Gap` value, such as `Gap::MissingEvidence{instance:"hermes", mechanism:"m", kind:EvidenceKind::Code}`. The non-Athena case asserts an empty result. The spec test asserts that `spec_gaps` does not list OLY-B-S4-01.
demonstrations.fails_without: If `check` ignored a kind, the matching exact-gap assertion fails. If it flagged non-Athena instances for missing records, the not-flagged test fails.
demonstrations.seam: Entry points: `mechanism_explanation::check` (added by steps 1-2) and, for the spec test, `hestia::{parse_spec, measure_problem, spec_gaps}` (exist, hestia.rs:1172, 1219, 1291). Fixtures: in-test `Explanation` values and the real docs/spec.toml. Nothing is faked.

demonstrations.method: The negative tests copy the real requirement and change one field. `spec_check_refuses_a_none_mechanism` sets mechanism `none` and asserts `spec_gaps(&[r])` has one gap with `no_mechanism`. Three more tests assert that a measure ending `status: requirement`, a measure without the test command, and owner `Hestia` are each refused by the label and owner helpers, as in study_instance_split.rs:294-312. The helpers `owner_problem` and `measure_label_problem` are copied into this file.
demonstrations.observes: The none-mechanism entry is reported as `no_mechanism`; the wrong label, the missing command and the wrong owner each give Some(problem).
demonstrations.fails_without: Without the real mechanism text the positive spec test fails. Without the helpers or the `spec_gaps` rule the negative tests fail. The none-mechanism test also shows that the original spec entry is a gap.
demonstrations.seam: Entry point: `hestia::spec_gaps` (exists, hestia.rs:1291) over a `SpecRequirement` cloned from the real entry with one field set to a bad value. Fixture: `parse_spec` on the real file, then an in-test field change. The seam exists, as used in study_instance_split.rs:284-312.
